datasets.name: Bijie landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: The Bijie dataset is available at http://gpcv.whu.edu.cn/data/Bijie_pages.html.

methods.name: TLSTMF-YOLO
methods.summary: TLSTMF-YOLO is an optimized YOLOv5-large network that integrates a C3-Swin-Transformer backbone for feature extraction, CBAM modules in the neck for attention, and a BiFPN structure for multiscale feature fusion. It is trained using an AdamW optimizer and a cosine learning rate strategy, and utilizes transfer learning to improve performance on small landslide datasets.
methods.verbatim: The code of this research is now published in https://github.com/mengshaoqiang/A-Transfer-Learning-Network-for-Earthquake-induced-Landslide-Remote-Sensing-Image-Detection.

code_links.name: Transfer learning network for earthquake-induced landslide detection in remote sensing images
code_links.summary: Custom code implementing a transfer learning network for detecting earthquake-induced landslides in remote sensing imagery, published as an open GitHub repository.

availability.author_statement: Full data and code availability statement, with shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The Bijie landslide dataset is linked and publicly available, and the custom TLSTMF-YOLO code is provided via a persistent GitHub repository link.
